scope: Automate the existing six-unit S1 size measurement, bounded ladder replay and interpreter-step observations; retain compact commit trends and locate regressions from those receipts. No optimization, new semantic authority, timing campaign or independent audit framework.

inputs.source_policy: Reuse the frozen S5 source/header identities, macro definitions and sealed AArch64 image; do not fetch a new source tree or refresh a frozen reference receipt.
inputs.measurement_policy: Measure the current compiler built in target/frontend/release. Historical object receipts may seed a historical row but cannot satisfy a fresh compile-time, step or correctness observation.
inputs.ladder_subset: Reuse the existing S5 mixed-link recipes: integer-mix, zlib compress/decompress, zstd compress/decompress, cJSON roundtrip. This is a selected-TU regression subset, not a full application-suite claim.
inputs.steps_subset: Reuse the N02 frozen deterministic corpus and its interpreter result/step output. The integer-mix control is mandatory. Library TUs without a standalone deterministic entry are not falsely assigned whole-library interpreter steps. The exact N02 plan digest accompanies the first live trend plan.

reuse.original_recipes: tools/ladder/eqsat_pilot.py:recipes and existing S5 mixed-link dependency objects
reuse.translation_validation: N02 execution and telemetry; do not add a second interpreter runner

metrics.primary: Per TU object .text plus .text.* bytes, separately for checked and unchecked. Report exact integer delta and ratio to the frozen GCC-14 -O2 unit, never a cross-family mean.
metrics.size_detail: Reuse S1 instruction bytes, padding bytes, in-text literal/data bytes and rodata bytes. Every fresh object is assembled twice and must be byte-identical. Section migration is not credited as a size reduction.
metrics.compile_time: Host release compiler wall nanoseconds for the frozen source-to-assembly command, separated from assembly, VM startup, linking and correctness replay. Three serial observations, median retained. This is a compiler-resource bound, not a native program latency claim.
metrics.steps: Exact EvoIR executed steps on each N02 frozen deterministic input, with correctness outcome and before/after result hashes. No timing surrogate is used for missing step observations.

regression_thresholds.text_bytes: Any positive per-unit delta is flagged; accepting a deliberate tradeoff requires the slice disposition, not changing history.

trend_contract.format: Append-only compact JSON records, one immutable completed observation per source revision and measurement variant; trend storage contains numeric observations, hashes and closed status tags, never raw assembly, objects, stdout or stderr.
trend_contract.provenance: Record the measured implementation commit, compiler hash, existing input/plan hashes and existing capture receipt hash. Reuse those identities; do not introduce signatures, a new trust layer or a second audit pass.
trend_contract.missing_data: Missing receipts or fields remain NOT_RUN or UNKNOWN. A historical size row without current compile time, steps and replay cannot satisfy the per-push measurement prerequisite.
trend_contract.append_behavior: An identical replay is idempotent. A conflicting record at the same observation key is rejected rather than overwriting prior evidence. A new measured retry receives its own observation identity and keeps the earlier failure.
trend_contract.view: Extend render-status with an explicit compact trend view: per-TU checked/unchecked baseline, current bytes, delta and GCC ratio, plus compile/steps bound disposition and ladder results. Rendering launches no build or test.

automation.trigger: A tracked pre-push entry point calls the existing bench adapter once for every newly pushed implementation revision that lacks the required receipt; no remote CI service or new daemon is introduced. Existing hooks must be preserved. The hook and its activation are reported separately until activation is exercised.
automation.no_hidden_build: The collector consumes the explicitly selected release binary; the orchestrating entry point performs the required serialized Cargo build once. Builds always use CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/frontend and CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2.
automation.schedule: The bounded subset is per push. Broader ladder runs reuse the existing bench command on the normal schedule; N05 does not launch a full kernel campaign.
automation.resource_or_tool_failure: Return a nonzero measurement status with the actual cause; do not synthesize a successful trend from old data or skip a required submeasurement silently.

bisect.interface: tools/bisect.py selects good/bad commits and a per-unit metric from retained trend records, traverses actual Git ancestry, and emits the earliest evidenced regression boundary.
bisect.search: Use retained comparable receipts first. Missing points request a measurement through the same bench entry point only when needed. Do not assume arbitrary history is monotonic: a binary narrowing is followed by checking earlier recorded transitions, or report the bounded interval rather than claiming a unique first bad commit.
bisect.missing_rebuild: Never create another worktree, clone or target. A rebuild at another revision requires an exclusively held, clean existing checkout; if it cannot be used safely, return the unresolved interval and exact missing commits instead of changing a dirty tree.
bisect.acceptance_experiment: Create a small local test branch containing good, deliberately size-regressed and later commits. Measure real emitted object bytes through S1, retain actual Git commit IDs and prove that the production trend comparator flags the regression and receipt-first bisect identifies the injected commit. Keep the mutation out of the published compiler path and remove temporary payloads afterward. This experiment proves detection/localization, not native semantic correctness of arbitrary history.

red_cases: A real emitted-object size increase is not currently collected automatically per revision or localized by the existing kernel unit-set ddmin tool.
An overwritten trend row hides a prior size regression: reject the conflicting append and preserve the original.
A missing commit receipt or incompatible input/profile must not be treated as a passing midpoint.
A later size recovery must not let bisect skip an earlier recorded regression.
A missing checked/unchecked twin or a missing N02 steps/ladder outcome must not count as a complete per-push observation.
A size increase in one TU must remain visible even when another family decreases more.
Two nonidentical object builds must fail the existing S1 contract before producing an admitted size row.

resources.temporary_objects: Hash, S1-measure, link/replay where required, then delete. Preserve only a minimal failing reproducer within the cap.
resources.forbidden: No extra target/worktree/kernel tree/large VM disk; no raw captures in Git; no removal of contracts, sealed fixtures, sole open-task evidence or Lean .lake.
resources.slice_end: Clean this slice's temporary products and record its disk net change.

acceptance: Plan committed before its RED or measurement execution.
Focused Python tests for trend, bisect and status rendering pass, including the injected real-commit regression.

Fresh current-revision observation includes all six S5 units, checked and unchecked S1 byte-identical twins, compile-time observations, the bounded ladder replay and N02 frozen interpreter-step observations.
The configured per-push entry point is actually exercised; document inactive delivery integrations rather than marking them enabled.
CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/frontend CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 tools/gate-changed.sh --full-workspace --offline passes with no selection filter.
Compact receipt, one-page notebook, TODO update and disk delta are committed together; render-status --todo passes after the TODO edit.
stop_rule: A two-week implementation box. If a prerequisite remains unavailable, retain completed tooling and measured evidence, identify the exact unmet acceptance row and continue another lane. Do not replace a live six-unit acceptance with fabricated receipts or claim full N05 closure from helper-only tests.
claim_ceiling: Per-revision deterministic object-size regression detection and bounded compiler-resource/correctness observations for the declared population. No latency, full-application, whole-compiler, verified-pass or product-target claim follows automatically.
